Songs on a Kashu Hijutsu apply on a failed save; without a save, a Wisdom save against your highest jutsu save DC. Pull The Strings: once per turn, a Hijutsu on a creature with a Mental condition: on a failure it uses its reaction to move its speed toward you. Echo Chamber: Kashu Hijutsu can come from up to two Doki (one instance per creature). Aggressive Tempo: allies in a Kashu Hijutsu's range are immune and gain +10 speed (+20 at 7th, +30 at 15th) and +2 jutsu damage (+4, +6) until the end of their next turn. Demonic Chorus: Kashu Genjutsu +2 damage per active Doki. Harmonious Bridge: once per turn, a Doki's hit lets one use Revolt of the Demon World on it.
